name: Aegis Dilemma: Veritas Omnia Vincit
source:
Several centuries have passed since the Blight Era ended. All the suffering of the time seems to be over. Enter the journey of Jules, a normal mercenary thrust into unusual circumstances and follow her journey to find the truth about herself and her close friends….
